title: Evidence map: does the cytokine storm KILL wild birds — or just accompany infection?

cells.text:
CXCL1, IL-1β, IL-6, TNF-α ↑
(brain, turbinate; Bov342)

type I/II/III IFN induction

note_box:
no study anywhere manipulates the storm and measures mortality —
the causal question is open even outside wild birds
caption: Cytokine induction is documented in mice, human cells, and chickens — but no study in any system manipulates the storm and tests mortality, and wild birds have no data at all.
